queryTargetName.description: Display name of the queried document, falling back to its last path segment or the account uid.

in.description: Parsed id of the document the query lists under.

mode.description: `Children` for direct children only, `AllDescendants` for the whole subtree.

interactionSummaries.description: Interaction counts per result, keyed by the result's `hm://` id.

accountsMetadata.description: Metadata payloads of the contributors shown on result cards, keyed by uid.

description: Everything a rendered Query block needs: the results plus per-item interaction summaries and author metadata.
